## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: breadth strong but mixed leadership and sizable large-cap divergences. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors: Industrials, Healthcare, Materials); confirmers: broad sector participation (9/11) and major-cap tech/AI names showing PRICE/period divergences (multiple LARGE caps BELOW TREND).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, UPS (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials strong: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strength: BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND.  
Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -12.11% | 1M: -12.93%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.89% | 1M: -18.15%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND; FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND; MMM (1W: +12.73% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND; BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND; AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/defensive mix.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -23.78%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -31.72%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -11.95% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology/high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: DOW (1W: +15.35%), FDX (1W: +14.58%), MMM (1W: +12.73%), BMY (1W: +12.61%), AMGN (1W: +12.41%) — strong cyclical momentum. Major divergence: several large-cap names (GOOGL, META, JPM, V, MA) show opposite 1W vs 1M signs → MAJOR DIVERGENCE; watch for trend breaks rather than broad positioning changes.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak; sector down 1W (-4.39%). AAPL (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +6.83%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier while MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.99% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND show broad selling.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Internal rotation with pockets of strength; JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +3.03% | 1M: -6.83%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -5.23%) RECOVERY but PYPL (1W: -23.29% | 1M: -30.92%) BELOW TREND highlights dispersion.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Constructive: BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +12.41% | 1M: +12.49%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +12.27%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +5.61% | 1M: +15.66%) ABOVE TREND show broad participation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclical/value exposure where momentum is clear (FDX, CAT, DOW, XOM) and maintain healthcare exposure (BMY, AMGN, JNJ); reduce exposure to high-multiple Technology names showing consistent BELOW TREND readings (ORCL, CRM, INTU, AMD). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given leadership and breadth, but CAUTION due to large-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.47% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -28.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +6.64%), Energy (1W: +5.18%), Materials (1W: +4.30%) — momentum leaders.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.39%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.11%) — monitor large-cap tech bleed and discretionary earnings/guide risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: breach of the 1M support band (sustained below recent 1M lows) would confirm further BELOW TREND pressure.  
MSFT: a follow-through below the 1M downtrend would signal extended tech rotation.  
JPM: daily/weekly close back above recent 1W highs would support the RECOVERY thesis.  
DOW/CAT: continued 1W outperformance holding ABOVE TREND validates cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
T (+80): AT&T plans $45B return to shareholders — Communication sector acting strong; price action (CHTR ABOVE TREND) confirms sector appetite.  
ISRG (+80): Intuitive Surgical cardiac approval expansion — ISRG price not detailed here but catalyst is actionable; cross-check for follow-through.  
JPM (+55): Apple Card issuance win; JPM (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirms short-term strength.  
LLY (+55): strong analyst growth outlook; LLY (1W: +2.03% | 1M: -4.50%) RECOVERY — bullish sentiment with 1W confirmation but 1M negative.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-50): PT cut cited; ORCL (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -25.74%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.  
NFLX (-60): antitrust probe headline; Netflix under pressure (sector communication dispersion) — watch for downside flow.  
ABT (-55): device recall updates; cross-check stock-level weakness (healthcare dispersion may increase) — potential downside confirmed in headlines.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION: Value/Cyclical style.  
Industrials and Healthcare showing strength — DOW (1W: +15.35% | 1M: +28.15%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +14.58% | 1M: +20.14%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +12.61% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: large-cap Technology divergence (MSFT, NVDA, ORCL BELOW TREND) and mixed news signals (e.g., CRM positive headlines but price BELOW TREND) — monitor for trend confirmation before increasing beta.
